opening.argument: The creator explains Hedget’s options platform, tokenomics, auction and FTX IEO procedures while addressing the risks of participating in the token sale. He does direct viewers to an FTX referral link and describes preparing funds and placing bids. But he also calls participation high risk, warns that profits may not materialize, and identifies the lack of a lock-in period as a drawback. The referral promotion sits within an explanation of how the investment works and what could go wrong, rather than a deceptive solicitation.
